notes.title: All difficulties implemented!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43575782/58179c00d7b3a560a1f0a1b408f6d2eff6752df9.jpg
[previewyoutube=FyLWUMYQ8dY;full][/previewyoutube]

This update took me nearly 2 weeks to pull off without breaking the entire game in the process.  I not only added 4 additional difficulties, but I had to also do the following:

 Re-scale Enemy HP and Damage for all 50 creatures
 Balance enemy typing speed, especially the easiest difficulty (1 letter every 10 seconds)
 Progression Maps for all new difficulties

Even I struggle with Myrmidon mode, and I am an expert typist.  I believe the game is balanced now.  What difficulty did you fit into?  Were you surprised?

Shawn Kilian
Game Developer & Ultramarathoner
